datasets.name: AI4Bharat Samanantar (Indic-English Parallel Corpus)
datasets.citation: Gowda et al. (2022). Samanantar: The largest publicly available parallel corpora collection for 11 Indic languages. Findings of EMNLP 2022.
preprocessing: Length Ratio Filtering (1 to 80 words, ratio <= 2.5)
datasets.record_split_policy: Split by original sentence ID before directional expansion (80% Train, 10% Val, 10% Test)
datasets.leakage_protection: 0% overlap across train/val/test splits enforced by cryptographic hashing
